chapter: Instruments, tenors and the current band
title: Criticism of Scott Hamilton for imitating older tenor styles
summary: Herman says Scott Hamilton plays well in the style of Ben Webster and others but that is all he does; he asks that this be passed on.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
